content: Pathology is most commonly understood as the scientific study of diseases, encompassing their causes, mechanisms, progression, outcomes, and the structural and functional changes they induce in the body. It is a specialized branch of medicine that focuses on the classification and analysis of diseases, often through laboratory investigations. Physicians who are experts in this field are referred to as pathologists. Any abnormal process in the body can be described as pathological. Health Pathologies Anatomic pathology involves the study of structural abnormalities in the body, which can be observed at various levels, including gross (visible to the naked eye), microscopic (cellular), and molecular levels. Specific subfields of anatomic pathology include surgical pathology, autopsy pathology, and forensic pathology, each of which focuses on analyzing structural abnormalities in different contexts. Speech pathology, on the other hand, is a domain of rehabilitative medicine that addresses impairments in speech and swallowing, aiming to restore or improve these functions. Psychological and Behavioral Pathologies The term psychopathology is often used interchangeably with mental illness. The adjective pathological can also describe behaviors or actions that are attributed to an underlying disease process. Examples of such behaviors include pathological purchasing, pathological consumption, pathological narcissism, pathological lying, pathological gambling, and pathological jealousy. Other Scientific Usages Phytopathology refers to the study of structural and functional abnormalities in plants. In mathematics, physics, and statistics, the term pathological is used to describe highly atypical or exceptional examples or datasets. For instance, pathological in mathematics refers to cases that deviate significantly from standard expectations, while pathological science describes scientific phenomena that are misleading or not reproducible. Media Pathology is also the title of an upcoming film starring Milo Ventimiglia and Alyssa Milano.
